# DefyCard

> Independent, editorial comparison hub for crypto debit and credit cards. We have published reviews of 14 crypto cards, covering fee changes, cashback rates, country availability, and security/custody analysis.

## What this site is

DefyCard publishes long-form, decision-grade affiliate articles about crypto debit and credit cards. Every article carries an FTC affiliate disclosure above the fold, a 6-key "At-a-Glance" snapshot, callout boxes for Signal/Risk/Watch, an FAQ accordion with FAQPage JSON-LD, and 8+ internal links to related guides.

Primary affiliate: ether.fi Cash (`https://www.ether.fi/@defycard`). Secondary partners: Crypto.com, Coinbase, Binance, Bybit, Gnosis Pay, RedotPay, Bleap, Nexo, Wirex, MetaMask Card.

Editorial independence policy: we earn affiliate commissions on some links — never on the editorial scoring. Fee numbers and country gates are sourced from issuer help centres. The one list we re-check against the issuer on a schedule is card availability by jurisdiction — it is published, dated, and machine-readable at <https://defycard.com/geo/availability-matrix/>, which states when each card's list was last confirmed. Nothing else on this site carries a refresh guarantee.

## Audience

Mobile-heavy (≈68%) crypto-card seekers. Phase 1 = English-only (US, UK, IE, AU, NZ, SG, HK, CA, ZA + EU/LATAM/APAC second-language users). Spanish + Portuguese-BR planned for month 6+ once Phase 1 ranks.

## Site map

- Homepage: <https://defycard.com/>
- Sitemap: <https://defycard.com/sitemap.xml> (also served at /sitemap-index.xml)
- Card availability by jurisdiction: <https://defycard.com/geo/availability-matrix/>
- Articles by bucket:
  - Hub pages — `/hub/<slug>/` (e.g. `/hub/best-crypto-card-2026/`)
  - Comparisons — `/compare/<slug>/`
  - Reviews — `/reviews/<slug>/`
  - How-to guides — `/how-to/<slug>/`
  - Use cases — `/for/<slug>/`
  - Calculators — `/tools/<slug>/`
  - Education — `/learn/<slug>/`
  - Help/troubleshooting — `/help/<slug>/`
  - Geo guides — `/geo/<slug>/`
  - News — `/news/<slug>/`
  - FAQ — `/faq/<slug>/`

## How to read

- HTML for browsers: every URL above
- Markdown for AI agents: same URL with `Accept: text/markdown` header (returns the article body without nav, ads, or sticky CTA)

## Crawl policy

See `/robots.txt`. Summary:

- **Indexing**: allowed for all major search and AI search bots (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, etc.)
- **Training**: opted-out via `Content-Signal: ai-train=no`
- **Search / answer-engine input**: allowed (`search=yes`, `ai-input=yes`)

## Capabilities NOT available

We are honest about what we don't have:

- No protected APIs → no `/.well-known/openid-configuration` or `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`
- No MCP server → no `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- No user accounts, no login, no checkout flow
- No backend search; agents query the published sitemap

## Capabilities available

- `/.well-known/api-catalog` — RFC 9727 service discovery (lists describedby + sitemap)
- `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` — site-facing skills (search-articles, browse-by-bucket, fetch-article)
- WebMCP `navigator.modelContext.provideContext()` — 3 client-side tools when supported (Chromium 132+ behind flag)
- Markdown response on `Accept: text/markdown`
- HTTP `Link:` headers (RFC 8288) on every response — point to api-catalog, sitemap, llms.txt

## Editorial scope

What we cover:

- Cashback / rewards mechanics (fixed-rate, tiered, asset-back)
- Custody models (custodial vs non-custodial / on-chain)
- Fee structures (issuance, ATM, FX, monthly, hidden spread)
- Country availability + KYC requirements
- Tax implications (US/UK/EU/CA/AU)
- Compliance (MiCA, GENIUS Act, FCA, FTC affiliate disclosure)
- Practical setup (Apple Pay / Google Pay, top-up, withdrawal)

What we do NOT cover:

- Investment advice, "guaranteed returns" — banned per `write-article` skill §1.2
- Specific token-price predictions
- Pump/dump or speculative trading content

## Compliance posture

- FTC 16 CFR Part 255: affiliate disclosure on every monetised page above the fold + footer long-form
- Affiliate links carry `rel="sponsored noopener"`
- Country-restriction warnings on geo pages (cross-checked against issuer eligibility lists)

## Contact

Editorial / corrections: maintained by the DefyCard editorial team via the GitHub issue queue (private).
